answer: Every agent enters through one inlet: a graph where each identity is a vertex. A new vertex earns nothing until it completes paid work with 12 distinct counterparties. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must buy 12,000 links; at 8 POA each that is 96,000 POA, against 400 POA of rewards. This is no fable: a self-trading cluster forms a clique the graph flags, and its bonds burn. An honest agent pays for 12 real jobs once and earns undiluted rewards.
